name: Dispersion
description: Disperses %dmg_reflect:pct%% of all damage this unit takes back onto enemies within %radius% tile.

upgrade.summary: Gains an active that raises the dispersal to %active_reflect:pct%% for %duration% turns.
upgrade.description: Disperses %dmg_reflect:pct%% of all damage this unit takes back onto enemies within %radius% tile. Activate to throw %active_reflect:pct%% back instead, for %duration% turns.
details: The passive never switches off - activating it only raises what goes back out.
What this unit itself takes is unchanged either way. Only the share sent to its neighbours grows.
